Let \(x\) be the mass of NaHCO₃ and \(15.00-x\) be the mass of MgCO₃.

Molar masses:
- NaHCO₃ = 84.006 g/mol
- Na₂CO₃ = 105.988 g/mol
- MgCO₃ = 84.313 g/mol
- MgO = 40.304 g/mol

Residue from NaHCO₃:
\[
2\text{NaHCO}_3 \rightarrow \text{Na}_2\text{CO}_3
\]
\[
\frac{105.988}{2(84.006)}x = 0.630836x
\]

Residue from MgCO₃:
\[
\text{MgCO}_3 \rightarrow \text{MgO}
\]
\[
\frac{40.304}{84.313}(15.00-x) = 0.478028(15.00-x)
\]

Total residue:
\[
0.630836x + 0.478028(15.00-x) = 8.80
\]
\[
0.152808x = 1.629575
\]
\[
x = 10.6642 \text{ g}
\]

Mass percentage of NaHCO₃:
\[
\frac{10.6642}{15.00} \times 100 = 71.1\%
\]

ANSWER: 71.1
